scripts.kill:9001: lsof -ti:9001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process found on port 9001'
scripts.kill:9000: lsof -ti:9000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process found on port 9000'
scripts.kill:4100: lsof -ti:4100 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process found on port 4100'
scripts.server:restart: npm run server:stop && sleep 2 && npm run server:start
scripts.server:status: pm2 list && (pgrep -f 'cloudflared.*tunnel.*run' > /dev/null && echo '✅ CloudFlare Tunnel running' || echo '❌ CloudFlare Tunnel not running') && echo 'DNS check for api.orchestratorai.io:' && dig +short api.orchestratorai.io | sed 's/^/  /' && echo 'Authoritative check:' && dig @quinton.ns.cloudflare.com +short A api.orchestratorai.io | sed 's/^/  /' && echo 'HTTPS HEAD check:' && (curl -sI https://api.orchestratorai.io | grep -Ei '^(server:|cf-ray:|date:)' || true)
scripts.prod:start: echo '⚠️  prod:start is deprecated. Use: npm run server:start' && npm run server:start
scripts.prod:stop: echo '⚠️  prod:stop is deprecated. Use: npm run server:stop' && npm run server:stop
scripts.prod:status: echo '⚠️  prod:status is deprecated. Use: npm run server:status' && npm run server:status
